title: The back gate stands before the colony's steps on the programme and is passable: it prints the moment the mouth is held, the colony prints meanwhile
context: The first cut of 2026-10-01-the-colony-grows put the colony's four steps before the back gate. --back-gate forces the door at sector 2 and found the gate waiting behind the farm (sector 3) and the chip plant (sector 4): a strictly ordered programme made the gate wait for buildings that were not due.
outcome: The back gate moved ahead of the armory and carries `passable: true`: due() passes over it while the mouth is not held and returns it first the moment it is. unlocked() in the sector loop now reads an empty `owed` list (the back gate and the launcher are passable, never owed). --grow, --colony, --back-gate and --skip-tutorial green.
alternatives: Marking the colony's steps passable instead: when their `when` holds they would still print ahead of a held gate
Keeping the colony after the gate: it would wait for the door at sector 7 or later, which is not a base that grows
